from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single provided paper, recording its title and which OTHER provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as found in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly cites or references")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all papers extracted from the document collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
